NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is required to take your profile photo, record video, and upload product images.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required to record audio when sharing a video.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is required to select your profile photo, images, and videos.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission is required to save your order images to your photo library.
